metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Alphabet, Tesla, Nestle, Intel

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 1 min ago
Stocks to Watch: Alphabet, Tesla, Nestle, Intel
↘️ Tesla (TSLA): Elon Musk’s EV maker reported negative free cash flow of more than $1 billion in the second quarter amid heavy spending on AI and robotics. Shares tumbled.
↘️ Alphabet (GOOGL): Shares slid after the tech company announced plans to significantly boost its capital expenditure.
↘️ Nestle (CH:NESN): Shares in the world’s largest food and beverage company fell after it posted disappointing half-year results and announced the sale of half of its water business.
